sample_unit: model responses (10 questions, 60 responses per model)

links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of AI-generated breast cancer patient information versus expert reference materials
links.effect: AI text was 2.60 grade levels lower than expert references (P<.001), but median FKGL was still 10.66 (ChatGPT-4.0) and 10.17 (DeepSeek-V3).
links.quote: AI models produced significantly more readable content than expert references (mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level difference -2.60; P<.001).

screen.reason: The study is an offline empirical comparison of two LLMs (ChatGPT-4.0 and DeepSeek-V3) answering breast cancer FAQs evaluated by human expert reviewers, without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
